summary.zh: 修复移动端阅读时 Obsidian 原生底栏反复显隐；统一阅读视图的导航栏状态，并改善灯绳跟随与加载期间侧边工具栏响应。
summary.en: Fixed repeated visibility changes in Obsidian's native mobile bars, unified reader navigation state, and improved the floating rail and toolbar response while content loads.

zh: 修复移动端阅读时 Obsidian 原生底栏反复显隐。
统一阅读视图导航栏状态，并改善灯绳跟随与加载期间侧边工具栏响应。
en: Fixed repeated visibility changes in Obsidian's native mobile bars while reading.
Unified reader navigation state and improved the floating rail and toolbar response while content loads.

summary.zh: 书架、RSS、Markdown 笔记和标注的侧栏操作更清楚，订阅列表与笔记卡片也更稳。
summary.en: Clearer sidebar actions for the bookshelf, RSS, Markdown notes, and annotations, with more reliable feed lists and note cards.

zh: 书架、订阅、笔记和标注可以在 Obsidian 原生侧栏中浏览；卡片上的标注入口只展示标注，点击某条标注才打开正文并定位。
RSS 订阅首次加载完成后会自动刷新列表；新正文写入失败时保留原有内容，避免缓存被空内容覆盖。
Markdown 笔记卡和阅读侧边工具栏统一使用图钉置顶；已有星标会保留为置顶，不需要重新标记。
卡片按钮外观更紧凑；Markdown 笔记预览会略过图片、代码块、引用块和空白内容，优先显示正文。
设置页、阅读外观面板和资源管理弹窗现在提供完整英文文案；语言可跟随 Obsidian 或手动切换。
en: Browse the bookshelf, feeds, notes, and annotations in Obsidian's native sidebar. Annotation links show the list first; selecting an annotation opens and locates its source text.
The feed list refreshes after its initial cache loads. If writing refreshed article content fails, the previous content stays available instead of being replaced with an empty snapshot.
Markdown note cards and the reading toolbar now use pin controls. Existing starred notes remain pinned without needing to be marked again.
Card actions are more compact. Markdown note previews skip images, code blocks, quotes, and empty content so the preview favors readable text.
Settings, reading appearance panels, and resource dialogs now have English copy. The interface can follow Obsidian's language or be switched manually.

summary.zh: Markdown 笔记卡的正文预览和图片缩略图异步加载后，不再把同组卡片和底部按钮一起撑高。
summary.en: Asynchronous Markdown previews and image thumbnails no longer resize a group of note cards or move their action bars.

zh: 笔记卡在读取和渲染正文预览时先保留稳定的两行空间，加载完成后不会突然撑高卡片或移动底部按钮。
空笔记、读取失败以及渲染后没有有效内容时，预览占位会自动收起，不会留下空白行。
在桌面、手机和平板的自动化布局回归中验证了长标题卡、正文预览和缩略图加载前后的高度与底栏位置。
en: Note cards reserve a stable two-line area while previews load, so a completed preview no longer grows the card or moves its action bar.
Empty notes, read failures, and previews with no renderable content collapse the reserved space instead of leaving a blank row.
Automated desktop, phone, and tablet layout checks cover card height and action-bar position before and after preview and thumbnail loading.

summary.zh: 把网页与文章内容清洗所用的 DOMPurify 更新到 3.4.17，避开 3.4.16 及以前版本报告的潜在漏洞范围。
summary.en: Updated DOMPurify, used to sanitize web and article HTML, to 3.4.17 outside the reported vulnerable range through 3.4.16.

zh: DOMPurify 从 3.4.16 更新到 3.4.17；现有正文清洗、RSS 阅读与笔记卡功能保持不变。
生产构建、类型检查、Markdown 笔记卡布局和 RSS 回归会随本次小版本重新验证。
en: Updated DOMPurify from 3.4.16 to 3.4.17 without changing content sanitization, RSS reading, or Markdown note-card behavior.
The patch release re-runs the production build, type check, Markdown note-card layout, and RSS regressions.

title.zh: 诊断日志与阅读稳定性修复
title.en: Diagnostic logging and reading stability fixes

summary.zh: 停止自动生成划词诊断文件，改为按需在内存中记录并手动导出；修复连续阅读中章节补载造成的正文跳动。
summary.en: Selection diagnostics now stay in memory only when enabled and are exported manually. Chapter loading no longer shifts visible text in continuous reading.

zh: 划词诊断统一受默认关闭的调试日志开关控制，不再自动向库中写文件，也不记录选中文字预览；关闭、清空或卸载时清除记录。
清空日志后新产生的划词现场也可以正常复制或保存，完整现场不会被普通日志的长度限制截断。
书架排除原有命名的划词诊断文件，文件创建、删除和移动后自动更新当前书架。
按章节实际占用高度保持阅读位置，修复首次补载、章节重新加载和书末收缩等情况下的正文跳动。
en: Selection diagnostics follow the diagnostic log toggle, which is off by default. They never write files automatically or retain selected-text previews; disabling, clearing, or unloading clears the records.
Selection snapshots recorded after clearing the log can still be copied or saved, and full snapshots are not truncated by the ordinary log message limit.
The bookshelf excludes recognized legacy selection diagnostic files and refreshes after file creation, deletion, or movement.
Visible text stays in place using actual chapter dimensions during initial loading, reloading, and shrinking near the end of a book.
